final: WITH units AS (SELECT s.sentreg, s.instownpct AS ownership, t.ordertypedist AS mix FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE s.instownpct IS NOT NULL AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL), baselines AS (SELECT mix, AVG(ownership) AS mix_baseline FROM units GROUP BY mix), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ownership) AS overall_average FROM units) SELECT AVG(u.ownership) AS average_ownership, AVG(u.ownership / b.mix_baseline) AS average_relative_to_mix, AVG(u.ownership - o.overall_average) AS average_excess FROM units AS u JOIN baselines AS b ON u.mix = b.mix CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE u.ownership > o.overall_average
